The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ag- and Gd-centered polyhedra.
